knowledge.purpose: Single-select from a small set of mutually exclusive options rendered as inline pill segments
useCases: Two-to-four way filter on a data band — with stateKey the value reaches the source's query
View or range switch (Day / Week / Month)

A short either/or answer inside a form (Yes / No) — give the options real booleans ({value:true} / {value:false}); with a name the shown value is submitted with the form, touched or not, as true/false
A question with no default answer — allowNone: nothing is lit until the visitor chooses
antiPatterns: Many options or long labels — use form.select
Multi-select — a segmented control holds exactly one value
Boolean on/off with no names for the two states — segments read as a choice between two named options, not as a switch
Writing "" as the value of the "no" option — use value:false (boolean mode) so the answer is a real false, not an empty string
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:
- Compact mode selector inside a toolbar

Narrow screens: the pills wrap onto a second line (wrap, default true); wrap:false keeps one row that scrolls with a visible scrollbar. Because the block is intrinsic, give it style.flex '0 1 auto' (and minWidth 0) when it sits beside a heading in a row.

Selected state: the chosen pill is filled in the brand with the on-primary ink and a 2px primary-ink edge — it clears 3:1 against the track and the other pills in every preset, light and derived dark. Unselected pills are transparent with muted ink.

Boolean mode: option values true/false (or valueType boolean) write real booleans to stateKey and submit true/false. allowNone (default for a single option): nothing selected until picked.

jsonSchema.description: Field name the value is submitted under when the control sits inside a form (a hidden input carries it).

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ label: string; value: string | number | boolean; color?: string }>

value.description: Text, or a real boolean for a yes/no answer ({label:"Yes", value:true}, {label:"No", value:false}) — never "" for no.

jsonSchema.description: The selected option (by value, or by its label). Unmatched: the first option — or nothing, with allowNone. null with allowNone: nothing selected.

What the control writes to state and submits. boolean: true/false as real booleans (visibleWhen and boolean fields read them; the text "false" is truthy). Unset: boolean when every option value is a boolean, else text.

Nothing is selected until the visitor picks, and clicking the lit pill again clears it; state and the form carry "" (text) or null (boolean). Unset: on for a one-option control (a consent pill must not start ticked), off otherwise.
On a narrow screen the pills wrap onto a second line (default). false keeps a single row that scrolls sideways with a visible scrollbar.

Surface state key the selected value is written to — on mount (the preselected value, or the first option) and on every change. A data source whose query filter reads {{state.<key>}} re-fetches on change — the control becomes the list's filter, and the filter matches the lit pill from the first render.
